title: Sparse corruption in low-rank matrix inference: the PCA benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2511.11927v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a standard tool for extracting a low-rank signal from noisy observations. It is known that when applying PCA to a rank-one signal corrupted by a dense, homogeneous noise, in the large matrix size limit, the BBP transition occurs, where the emergence of an outlying eigenvalue and the alignment of the corresponding eigenvector occur at the same critical signal strength. Here we study the case of sparse noise corruption. The noise matrix is modelled as the adjacency matrix of a weighted undirected graph with finite average connectivity. Using the replica method, we analytically compute the typical top eigenvalue, the top eigenvector component density, and the overlap with the signal, through recursive distributional equations solved by population dynamics. We identify two signal-strength transitions as functions of graph connectivity: $\theta_{\rm crit}$, marking signal recovery by the top eig

translated_title: 低秩矩阵推断中的稀疏损坏：PCA基准测试
translated_abstract: 主成分分析（PCA）是从含噪观测中提取低秩信号的标准工具。众所周知，当将PCA应用于被稠密、均匀噪声损坏的秩一信号时，在大矩阵尺寸极限下会出现BBP转变：离群特征值的涌现与相应特征向量的对齐发生在同一临界信号强度处。本文研究稀疏噪声损坏的情形。噪声矩阵被建模为具有有限平均连通度的加权无向图的邻接矩阵。利用复制方法，我们通过由种群动力学求解的递归分布方程，解析地计算了典型的最大特征值、最大特征向量分量密度以及与信号的重叠度。我们识别出两个作为图连通度函数的信号强度转变：θ_crit，标记通过最大特征向量实现信号恢复……
tldr: 该论文研究了稀疏噪声（建模为有限平均连通度的加权图邻接矩阵）损坏下低秩信号的PCA推断问题，利用复制方法与种群动力学解析计算了最大特征值、特征向量分量密度及信号重叠度，并识别出随图连通度变化的两个信号强度转变点。
